main_text.p: Mawia, Arabum reginæ frequens apud Historiæ Ecclesiasticæ Scriptores mentio. at cui genti præfuit? In regum certe Hirenfium serie fœmina percelebris hoc nomine occurrit, AmrilKaisi regis 14ti conjux, Almondari 15ti mater, at ut eam esse, cujus meminerunt Historici, credamus, non fert annorum ratio cum eam sub Valentiniano collocent, hæc autem ad Justiniani tempora propius accedat. Al-Mondarus enim ipsius filius is videtur cujus in bellis inter Imperatores Romanos & Kobadem ac Annsherwa-num (quem titulo pluribus communi, Cosroem vocant Graci) Persiæ reges; mentio, ac idem forsan ad quem missum à Justino legatum scribit Gregorius noster his verbis

وفي هذه السنة وجد يوسطينيا دوس وفد [?] الى المنذر ملك العرب لمصالحة لاته كان [?] غزا الروم وخرب وسبي وكان سبب الفتنة [?] بين العرب والروم اضطهاد الملك يوسطينيا دوس [?] الابناء القابلين بالطبيعة الواحدة لا ان النصاري [?] العرب يومين اذ كانوا يعتقدون اعتقاد اليعاقبة [?] لا غ [illegible, ~2 letters] ٭
i. e. Eoque anno (sc.7o imperii sui) mi-

fit Justinianus (l. Justinus, nam & hunc Justinianum vocat, atque ita tres ordine recenset Justinianos) le-v. Euagr. l.4.c.12.gatum ad Al Mondarum regem Arabum, ut pacis cum eo fœdera sanciret, quoniam ille Romanorum ditionem hostiliter invaserat, eámque vastaverat, ac multos abduxerat captivos. causa autem inter Arabes & Romanos dissidii erat, quod persequeretur Rex Iustinianus patres illos qui unam in Christo naturam asserrent, cum qui tunc temporis erant apud Arabes Christiani non aliam quam Iacobitarum

page.notes: The Arabic passage is set in a different script and is only partly legible on the scan. Words marked [?] are uncertain, and the last line is damaged at its left end. The Arabic lines have been run together into one paragraph. The left margin note "v. Euagr. l.4.c.12." has no reference mark in the text, so its placement is by position. The Greek-style letters and the superscripts "ti" and "o" follow the print as seen.
